purpose: Fifth bounded internet verification group covering the six remaining unaudited batch-51 candidates while the same V53 browser-acceptance task remains unclaimed. No second runner, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_route_policy: Only first-party operator or owner sites, GOV.UK Companies House records and local-authority pages count as verified. A verified company or site route does not prove current occupation, lease continuation, legal completion or exact parcel identity.
method.historical_status_policy: Sold, Sold Prior and Withdrawn Post remain historical source statements and are not promoted to current availability or legal completion.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical parcel geometry is read.
